key_points.text: My guest this week is Ryan Caldbeck, a private equity investor who wants to bring quantitative rigor to the private markets.
key_points.evidence_quote: My guest this week is Ryan Caldbeck, a private equity investor who wants to bring quantitative rigor to the private markets.

thesis: The speaker describes the evolution of a quantitative investment platform called Helio, which began as a tool to replicate a private equity investor's subjective decision-making process by filtering companies based on financials like revenue and gross margins. Over time, the firm shifted its objective measure from subjective acceptance to objective success metrics, ultimately identifying revenue growth as the primary predictor for company success in private markets.
